_comment: Team VPN accounts (realm 'team', prod). setup.sh creates missing ones on every Keycloak start and keeps the group
'vpn' (and the role 'superadmin') equal to this list: remove a person here = no new VPN logins after the next start.
username = VPN name = their personal environment in NNA-deployment k8s/personal.json (must match exactly).
superadmin: true = VPN admin (all servers, every environment, HSA Work). Login = password + PASSKEY (Face ID/
fingerprint), no code. Everyone else: password + authenticator code. Also add the e-mail to Headscale's oidc.allowed_users.
New accounts have no password: 'Forgot password?' on the login page (mail to the address below), then the second factor.
